say:1:1610401001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Pippa, Cassadee, and Gervan! We're now officially rivals!
say:1:1610401001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Pippa, Cassadee, and Gervan! We're now officially rivals!
say:1:1610401001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Pippa, Cassadee, and Gervan! We're now officially rivals!

say:2:1610401002:1.text: I'm no match for you, let alone Cassadee or Gervan. I just hope I can pass the first test. If I'm lucky, maybe I can pass the second one as well.
say:2:1610401002:1.source_cn: 欸？我……我可比不过你呀，更别提科丝蒂和格墨文了。只希...

say:3:1610401003:1.text: You never know, Pippa. Maybe you'll hit the jackpot this time and become the winner of the whole thing. I'd love to see you as a court mage.
say:3:1610401003:1.source_cn: 皮帕，说不定你运气好到爆炸，会成为最后的唯一胜利者，当...

say:4:1610401004:1.text: Me as a court mage? I wouldn't know what to do. Can I choose not to become one?
say:4:1610401004:1.source_cn: 啊？可、可是我不知道该怎么当宫廷魔法师啊……我能不能不当……

choice_prompt:5:1610401004.text: Me as a court mage? I wouldn't know what to do. Can I choose not to become one?
choice_prompt:5:1610401004.source_cn: 啊？可、可是我不知道该怎么当宫廷魔法师啊……我能不能不当……

say:8:1610401006:2.text: Haha... I'd love to see you wearing the court mage outfit. You'd look so cute!
say:8:1610401006:2.source_cn: 哈哈哈……皮帕，我突然也想看看你穿上宫廷魔法师制服的样...

say:10:1610401007:1.text: But let's get back on topic. The screening stage eliminated more than half of the participants, which means that the difficulty of the first test will definitely be high.
say:10:1610401007:1.source_cn: 话说回来，寻找日时仪钥匙的筛选题目就已经将一大半报名者...

say:12:1610401008:1.text: I think so too. How about we turn this endeavor into a trial of speed and skill? Who among us can pass through the three islands the fastest?
say:12:1610401008:1.source_cn: 我也这么想。正好，我们要不要来场比赛？看谁能最快通过三...

say:13:1610401009:1.text: You know how competitive I am, Gervan. Maybe it's finally time for me to show you all what I can do.
say:13:1610401009:1.source_cn: 比赛？好啊！说不定我突然大展神威，赢过了你们所有人呢！

say:14:1610401010:1.text: Confident as always, Silven. I look forward to your performance. Let's all do our best and stay safe out there.
say:14:1610401010:1.source_cn: 这么有信心？休，我很期待你的表现。全力以赴，别大意了。

say:19:1610401012:1.text: What? It's starting already?! I've got to try not to fall behind!
say:19:1610401012:1.source_cn: ……欸？这就开始了？我、我要加油，不能落后！

choice:5:0:1.text: Well, the test hasn't started yet...
choice:5:0:1.male: Well, the test hasn't started yet...
choice:5:0:1.female: Well, the test hasn't started yet...

say:0:1610402001:0.text: Alright, let's start with this portal!
say:0:1610402001:0.source_cn: 决定了，就从这扇传送门开始！
say:0:1610402001:0.male: Alright, let's start with this portal!
say:0:1610402001:0.female: Alright, let's start with this portal!

narration:1:1610403001:1.text: The headmaster's voice echoes through the air. "Through the lava's embers, defeat the defenders."

say:0:1610404001:0.text: At this distance, if I turn into a wolf, I can make it across.
say:0:1610404001:0.source_cn: 这个距离，变成狼应该能跳跃过去吧？
say:0:1610404001:0.male: At this distance, if I turn into a wolf, I can make it across.
say:0:1610404001:0.female: At this distance, if I turn into a wolf, I can make it across.

say:0:1610405001:0.text: Fire elementals? The Serene Lyceum sure has a lot of surprises.
say:0:1610405001:0.source_cn: 火元素？莱希拉姆的考试资源倒是很丰富嘛。
say:0:1610405001:0.male: Fire elementals? The Serene Lyceum sure has a lot of surprises.
say:0:1610405001:0.female: Fire elementals? The Serene Lyceum sure has a lot of surprises.

say:0:1610406001:0.text: I can't waste any more time. I have to speed up.
say:0:1610406001:0.source_cn: 不能浪费时间，我得加快速度了。
say:0:1610406001:0.male: I can't waste any more time. I have to speed up.
say:0:1610406001:0.female: I can't waste any more time. I have to speed up.

say:0:1610408001:0.text: I'm becoming more and more proficient at transfiguration.
say:0:1610408001:0.source_cn: 越来越熟练了，变形术真是个有趣的魔法。
say:0:1610408001:0.male: I'm becoming more and more proficient at transfiguration.
say:0:1610408001:0.female: I'm becoming more and more proficient at transfiguration.

say:0:1610410001:0.text: Although you may not understand, I'll still say sorry in advance. I'll make this quick.
say:0:1610410001:0.source_cn: 虽然你听不懂，但我还是得先说声抱歉，我会速战速决。
say:0:1610410001:0.male: Although you may not understand, I'll still say sorry in advance. I'll make this quick.
say:0:1610410001:0.female: Although you may not understand, I'll still say sorry in advance. I'll make this quick.

say:0:1610411001:0.text: There are still two islands to go. I need to hurry up.
say:0:1610411001:0.source_cn: 还有两处岛屿要去，我得加快速度了。
say:0:1610411001:0.male: There are still two islands to go. I need to hurry up.
say:0:1610411001:0.female: There are still two islands to go. I need to hurry up.

narration:0:1610412001:0.text: The challenge is over, and you are teleported back to the Interrealm.
narration:0:1610412001:0.source_cn: 挑战结束，你被传送回了界域之间
narration:0:1610412001:0.male: The challenge is over, and you are teleported back to the Interrealm.
narration:0:1610412001:0.female: The challenge is over, and you are teleported back to the Interrealm.

narration:1:1610412002:0.text: Meanwhile, in the viewing box of the selection judges...
narration:1:1610412002:0.source_cn: 与此同时，在选拔赛评审团的观战区中——
narration:1:1610412002:0.male: Meanwhile, in the viewing box of the selection judges...
narration:1:1610412002:0.female: Meanwhile, in the viewing box of the selection judges...

say:3:1610412003:1.text: Interesting... This student, who defeated the monster first, seems to have much stronger control and understanding of magic than the others.
say:3:1610412003:1.source_cn: 嗯……有意思，这位第一个击败怪物的学生，对魔法的掌控和...
say:3:1610412003:1.male: Interesting... This student, who defeated the monster first, seems to have much stronger control and understanding of magic than the others.
say:3:1610412003:1.female: Interesting... This student, who defeated the monster first, seems to have much stronger control and understanding of magic than the others.

say:4:1610412004:1.text: No need for such wide eyes, Cyran. Some students are just born with a little extra sparkle in their wand, don't you know?
say:4:1610412004:1.source_cn: 喔哈哈，这不是什么值得大惊小怪的事情，总有些人是天赋异...

say:5:1610412005:1.text: Ah, I still recall the exceptional spark you showed in your youth! Seeing the mage you've become... it truly warms this old heart. I'm so very proud of you.
say:5:1610412005:1.source_cn: 我记得你当年在学校的时候也是天赋卓越的学生，这从你现在...

say:6:1610412006:1.text: Your acknowledgment is... appreciated, Headmaster. One can only hope your physical vigor has managed to keep pace with your nostalgic sentiments.
say:6:1610412006:1.source_cn: 感谢你的肯定，校长先生，不知道你的身体是否也像过去一样...

say:7:1610412007:1.text: Goodness me, this old vessel may have a few more creaks than it did two decades past, but everything still sails! You, on the other hand, look like a wandering ghost. A bit of sun would do you wonders!
say:7:1610412007:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，我的身体虽然不如二十多年前那么强壮，偶尔会有些...

say:8:1610412008:1.text: Looks like the royal court of Savannah has done what final exams never could. They've sucked the life right out of our brightest graduate.
say:8:1610412008:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，赛凡纳王室终于把莱希拉姆最优秀的毕业生也折磨...

say:9:1610412009:1.text: Oh, Headmaster, you and your jests. But come now, let's not pretend. We both know who the Lyceum's brightest graduate is.
say:9:1610412009:1.source_cn: 呵，校长先生，你还是一如既往的风趣。你我都知道，“最优...

say:10:1610412010:1.text: As for this year's class... I heard even before I arrived that there are a few exceptional students: Cassadee and Gervan.
say:10:1610412010:1.source_cn: 至于这一届……我在来之前就听闻这一届有几位非常出色的学...
say:10:1610412010:1.male: As for this year's class... I heard even before I arrived that there are a few exceptional students: Cassadee and Gervan.
say:10:1610412010:1.female: As for this year's class... I heard even before I arrived that there are a few exceptional students: Cassadee and Gervan.

say:11:1610412011:1.text: But now it seems that none of them can compare to...
say:11:1610412011:1.source_cn: 但现在看来，他们似乎都比不上这位……
say:11:1610412011:1.male: But now it seems that none of them can compare to...
say:11:1610412011:1.female: But now it seems that none of them can compare to...

say:13:1610412013:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... It seems I've heard a similar name from afar. Strange, isn't it? For someone with his raw talent to be so overlooked, while everyone chatters on about Cassadee and Gervan.
say:13:1610412013:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... It seems I've heard a similar name from afar. Strange, isn't it? For someone with his raw talent to be so overlooked, while everyone chatters on about Cassadee and Gervan.
say:13:1610412013:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>... It seems I've heard a similar name from afar. Strange, isn't it? For someone with her raw talent to be so overlooked, while everyone chatters on about Cassadee and Gervan.

say:14:1610412014:1.text: For some, being widely renowned isn't necessarily better than being obscure.
say:14:1610412014:1.source_cn: 呵、呵、呵！对学生来说，声名显赫不见得比默默无闻更好。

say:15:1610412015:1.text: He must also be a student who was admitted through special admissions.
say:15:1610412015:1.male: He must also be a student who was admitted through special admissions.
say:15:1610412015:1.female: She must also be a student who was admitted through special admissions.

say:17:1610412016:1.text: And yet, he lacks both title and renown. A commoner with no name to speak of... simply "<style="stress"><player_name></style>". How... curiously quaint.
say:17:1610412016:1.male: And yet, he lacks both title and renown. A commoner with no name to speak of... simply "<style="stress"><player_name></style>". How... curiously quaint.
say:17:1610412016:1.female: And yet, she lacks both title and renown. A commoner with no name to speak of... simply "<style="stress"><player_name></style>". How... curiously quaint.

say:18:1610412017:1.text: Hahaha... For a court mage to bestow such attention upon an ordinary student, it seems this year's class is truly exceptionally gifted.
say:18:1610412017:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，宫廷魔法师竟然会对一位普通学生投以这么高的关注...
say:18:1610412017:1.male: Hahaha... For a court mage to bestow such attention upon an ordinary student, it seems this year's class is truly exceptionally gifted.
say:18:1610412017:1.female: Hahaha... For a court mage to bestow such attention upon an ordinary student, it seems this year's class is truly exceptionally gifted.

say:19:1610412018:1.text: Look! Those excellent candidates have already passed the first test!
say:19:1610412018:1.source_cn: 瞧——那些优秀的候选者已经纷纷通过第一关了。

say:0:1610413001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you've also passed through the first island!
say:0:1610413001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you've also passed through the first island!
say:0:1610413001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you've also passed through the first island!

say:3:1610414002:1.text: I agree. I spent quite a bit of time defeating it.
say:3:1610414002:1.source_cn: 嗯，确实，我也花费了不少精力才战胜它的。
say:3:1610414002:1.male: I agree. I spent quite a bit of time defeating it.
say:3:1610414002:1.female: I agree. I spent quite a bit of time defeating it.

say:5:1610414004:0.text: Hey, it's Gervan... Look, Silven made it here also!
say:5:1610414004:0.source_cn: 咦，格墨文回来了……看，休也从传送门里出来了！
say:5:1610414004:0.male: Hey, it's Gervan... Look, Silven made it here also!
say:5:1610414004:0.female: Hey, it's Gervan... Look, Silven made it here also!

say:8:1610414005:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂，看来你是第一个？

say:11:1610414007:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you truly are a formidable opponent.
say:11:1610414007:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you truly are a formidable opponent.
say:11:1610414007:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you truly are a formidable opponent.

choice_prompt:12:1610414007.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you truly are a formidable opponent.
choice_prompt:12:1610414007.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，你的确很强大，是位强劲的对手。
choice_prompt:12:1610414007.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you truly are a formidable opponent.
choice_prompt:12:1610414007.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you truly are a formidable opponent.

say:13:1610414008:1.text: Yes, I don't want this competition to affect our friendship.
say:13:1610414008:1.source_cn: 没错，我也不希望因为比赛而影响了我们之间的友谊。
say:13:1610414008:1.male: Yes, I don't want this competition to affect our friendship.
say:13:1610414008:1.female: Yes, I don't want this competition to affect our friendship.

say:14:1610414011:1.text: Where's Pippa? Have you seen her?
say:14:1610414011:1.source_cn: 皮帕呢？你们见到她了吗？

say:15:1610414012:1.text: Not yet... Should we wait for her?
say:15:1610414012:1.source_cn: 还没有……要等她一会儿吗？

say:16:1610414013:1.text: There are still two islands left to clear. I suggest we simply continue on.
say:16:1610414013:1.source_cn: 还有两个岛屿没有通过，我们还是先继续吧。

choice:12:0:1.text: This is a friendly competition only.
choice:12:0:1.male: This is a friendly competition only.
choice:12:0:1.female: This is a friendly competition only.

say:18:1610414009:1.text: It seems that our ideas are very much in agreement.
say:18:1610414009:1.source_cn: 看来我们的想法很一致。
say:18:1610414009:1.male: It seems that our ideas are very much in agreement.
say:18:1610414009:1.female: It seems that our ideas are very much in agreement.

choice:12:1:2.text: I mean, who doesn't want to be first?
choice:12:1:2.male: I mean, who doesn't want to be first?
choice:12:1:2.female: I mean, who doesn't want to be first?

say:19:1610414010:1.text: Indeed! The true prize isn't always first place, but the growth you earn through your efforts.
say:19:1610414010:1.source_cn: 嗯！只要努力去做，哪怕不是第一名，也一定会有别的收获的！
say:19:1610414010:1.male: Indeed! The true prize isn't always first place, but the growth you earn through your efforts.
say:19:1610414010:1.female: Indeed! The true prize isn't always first place, but the growth you earn through your efforts.

choice:12:2:3.source_cn: 无所谓名次，尽全力就好

say:20:1610414003:1.text: I knew you would be the fastest, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:20:1610414003:1.male: I knew you would be the fastest, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:20:1610414003:1.female: I knew you would be the fastest, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

choice:2:1:2.text: It was a walk in the park.
choice:2:1:2.male: It was a walk in the park.
choice:2:1:2.female: It was a walk in the park.

narration:1:1610415001:1.text: The headmaster's voice echoes through the air. "Cross the devouring mire, and put the mud monster to fire."

say:0:1610416001:0.text: It seems that I have to go through the platform in the middle to fight that sticky behemoth.
say:0:1610416001:0.source_cn: 看来得通过中间的高台，才能和那个黏糊糊的大家伙战斗。
say:0:1610416001:0.male: It seems that I have to go through the platform in the middle to fight that sticky behemoth.
say:0:1610416001:0.female: It seems that I have to go through the platform in the middle to fight that sticky behemoth.

say:0:1610417001:0.text: I have to go down from here. I guess there will be many monsters blocking the way down there.
say:0:1610417001:0.source_cn: 得从这里下去。我猜下面一定会有许多拦路怪物，唉，一点新...
say:0:1610417001:0.male: I have to go down from here. I guess there will be many monsters blocking the way down there.
say:0:1610417001:0.female: I have to go down from here. I guess there will be many monsters blocking the way down there.

say:1:1610419001:0.text: The competition is fierce! All participants, best of luck to you all!
say:1:1610419001:0.source_cn: 赛场情况非常焦灼！请各位参赛者抓紧时间战斗。

say:0:1610420001:0.text: Why is this part of the selection?! The stench here is insane!
say:0:1610420001:0.source_cn: 唉，干嘛非要用这家伙来考试啊，站在这里都闻能到它身上的...
say:0:1610420001:0.male: Why is this part of the selection?! The stench here is insane!
say:0:1610420001:0.female: Why is this part of the selection?! The stench here is insane!

say:0:1610421001:0.text: They must've deliberately chosen this kind of monster to get on everyone's nerves...
say:0:1610421001:0.source_cn: 出题人选用这种怪物一定是故意的……
say:0:1610421001:0.male: They must've deliberately chosen this kind of monster to get on everyone's nerves...
say:0:1610421001:0.female: They must've deliberately chosen this kind of monster to get on everyone's nerves...

narration:0:1610422001:1.text: The challenge is over, and you return to the Interrealm.
narration:0:1610422001:1.male: The challenge is over, and you return to the Interrealm.
narration:0:1610422001:1.female: The challenge is over, and you return to the Interrealm.

narration:2:1610422002:0.text: In the viewing box, Cyran claps politely.
narration:2:1610422002:0.source_cn: 观战区中，迪尔格雷礼貌性地鼓了鼓掌

say:4:1610422003:1.text: What did I tell you? Every single student here has the potential to become an excellent court mage! It's too bad your purse strings are so tight.
say:4:1610422003:1.source_cn: 怎么样，我早就说过了，这里的每一位学生都能成为出色的宫...

say:5:1610422004:1.text: I urge the royal court to increase the budget at once... double it, triple it, even tenfold if possible! Every coin invested in magic will yield returns beyond imagination.
say:5:1610422004:1.source_cn: 我建议王室尽快提高预算，两倍，三倍，甚至十倍！花在魔法...

say:6:1610422005:1.text: ... Thank you for your suggestion, Headmaster. You can be certain I will present your... ambitious proposal to His Majesty.
say:6:1610422005:1.source_cn: ……感谢你的建议，校长先生，我会转达给国王陛下的。

say:7:1610422006:1.text: Speaking of which... that student named <style="stress"><player_name></style> performed remarkably well once again. Let me think, where have I seen such an outstanding talent before?
say:7:1610422006:1.male: Speaking of which... that student named <style="stress"><player_name></style> performed remarkably well once again. Let me think, where have I seen such an outstanding talent before?
say:7:1610422006:1.female: Speaking of which... that student named <style="stress"><player_name></style> performed remarkably well once again. Let me think, where have I seen such an outstanding talent before?

say:8:1610422007:1.text: Is he the one I met in the Duchy of Whiteridge?
say:8:1610422007:1.male: Is he the one I met in the Duchy of Whiteridge?
say:8:1610422007:1.female: Is she the one I met in the Duchy of Whiteridge?

say:9:1610422008:1.text: The Duchy of Whiteridge, you say? That region has produced quite a few renowned mages... Lady Anathyme, founder of alchemy at the Lyceum, and the famed elemental mage, Magister Lorence, to name a few.
say:9:1610422008:1.source_cn: 白山公国？嚯嚯，那里可孕育出了不少知名魔法师，例如莱希...

say:10:1610422009:1.text: Yes, yes, Headmaster. The history lessons taught in the Lyceum are still etched in my memory. I can recall the exploits of our illustrious forebearers in exquisite detail.
say:10:1610422009:1.source_cn: 当然，当然，校长先生，莱希拉姆所教授的历史还印刻在记忆...

say:12:1610422011:1.text: Goodness me! Don't tell me the royal court has particular preferences regarding one's place of origin.
say:12:1610422011:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，莫非王室对特定地域出身的人有偏见？

say:13:1610422012:1.text: Haha... How could that be? Stop joking, Headmaster.
say:13:1610422012:1.source_cn: 哈哈……怎么会呢？你说笑了，校长先生。

say:14:1610422013:1.text: Of course, I haven't been able to hear well lately without using amplification magic, so I didn't catch a word you just said.
say:14:1610422013:1.source_cn: 对嘛。我最近不用扩音魔法就听不清楚。所以你刚才问了什么...

say:15:1610422014:1.text: Oh, look! The place is a complete mess!
say:15:1610422014:1.source_cn: ——瞧，考试场地里真是一片混乱！

say:0:1610423001:0.text: I can finally take a breath. Let's go back and check. Maybe I'll be the first one out again.
say:0:1610423001:0.source_cn: 呼……总算能深呼吸了。先回去看看，说不定我又是第一个出...
say:0:1610423001:0.male: I can finally take a breath. Let's go back and check. Maybe I'll be the first one out again.
say:0:1610423001:0.female: I can finally take a breath. Let's go back and check. Maybe I'll be the first one out again.

say:0:1610447001:0.text: Today's exam is held at the <style="highlight">Blooming Atelier's gallery</style>. I have to hurry there.

say:5:1610438002:1.text: Attention, please. The first round of the selection has concluded. The results will now be announced by Magister Cyran.
say:5:1610438002:1.source_cn: 注意了，选拔赛第一场已经结束，现在由迪尔格雷宣布选拔结果。

say:7:1610438003:1.text: According to the rules, those who successfully pass through all islands with the shortest completion times will be ranked highest.
say:7:1610438003:1.source_cn: 参加今日选拔赛的考生一共有五十七位，依照规则，顺利通过...

say:9:1610438005:1.text: I will now announce the names of these ten individuals.
say:9:1610438005:1.source_cn: 现在公布这十人的姓名。

say:10:1610438006:1.text: In first place... <style="stress"><player_name></style>. A student worthy of attention.
say:10:1610438006:1.male: In first place... <style="stress"><player_name></style>. A student worthy of attention.
say:10:1610438006:1.female: In first place... <style="stress"><player_name></style>. A student worthy of attention.

say:11:1610438007:1.text: Second place goes to Cassadee, followed by Gervan in third.
say:11:1610438007:1.source_cn: 第二名，科丝蒂；第三名，格墨文。

say:12:1610438008:1.text: Cyran announces each student's name one by one. You hear many familiar names, right up until the final one...
say:12:1610438008:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷一一报出学生的姓名，你听到了各种熟悉的名字，直...
say:12:1610438008:1.male: Cyran announces each student's name one by one. You hear many familiar names, right up until the final one...
say:12:1610438008:1.female: Cyran announces each student's name one by one. You hear many familiar names, right up until the final one...

say:13:1610438009:1.text: In tenth place, Pippa. A fortunate individual. She was merely three seconds ahead of the candidate in eleventh place. Congratulations.
say:13:1610438009:1.source_cn: ……第十名，皮帕小姐，一位幸运的朋友。她与第十一名只有...

say:17:1610438011:1.text: You ten, mark this well: <style="highlight">Tomorrow at 9 a.m.</style>, assemble at the <style="highlight">Blooming Atelier</style> to prepare for the second selection exam.

say:18:1610438012:0.text: I very much look forward to your performances.
say:18:1610438012:0.source_cn: 我很期待你们明天的表现。

narration:21:1610438013:0.text: After his announcement, Cyran leaves through the large portal.
narration:21:1610438013:0.source_cn: 公布完成绩后，迪尔格雷又一次通过大传送门离开了

say:23:1610438014:1.text: Congratulations, everyone! And of course, congrats to me too! We all passed today's test!
say:23:1610438014:1.source_cn: 恭喜各位，当然也恭喜我自己，我们都通过了今天的选拔！

say:25:1610438015:1.text: Just now, I was so nervous that my tail almost stood up!
say:25:1610438015:1.source_cn: 刚才迪尔格雷大人宣布名单的时候，我、我紧张得尾巴都要竖...

say:27:1610438016:1.text: We can't be careless now. Tomorrow's test will definitely be harder than today's. I should go back early to prepare.
say:27:1610438016:1.source_cn: 不能大意，明天的考试一定比今天的还要难，我们得早点回去...

say:29:1610438017:1.text: Well then, I'll take my leave now. See you tomorrow. Silven, would you like to head back together?
say:29:1610438017:1.source_cn: 嗯，那我就先告辞了，明天再见。休，你要一起走吗？

say:30:1610438018:1.text: Yeah, sure. See you all tomorrow!

choice_prompt:32:1610438018.text: Yeah, sure. See you all tomorrow!

say:33:1610438019:1.source_cn: 那我也先回家了，咱们明天见！

choice:32:1:2.source_cn: 累死了，我得好好睡一觉
